title: Who does the housework?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What is the fairest way for people in a household to divide housework?
Should housework be divided equally by time, by preference, or by who has more free time?
Why is invisible work such as planning meals or remembering appointments often overlooked?
Should children receive money for doing household chores?
What household task do you dislike most, and what would you gladly trade it for?
